title: Corporate Gym Discounts in NZ — How to Get a Cheaper Membership Through Work
meta_desc: Get cheaper gym memberships with corporate discounts from NZHL and Southern Cross
intro: Many Kiwis are unaware that their employer can negotiate discounted gym memberships. With prices starting from $16.95 per week at Jetts 24/7 Gym, a corporate discount can lead to significant savings. Corporate gym discounts are a win-win for employees and employers, promoting employee wellness while reducing costs.

sections.heading: How Corporate Gym Discounts Work
sections.body: Corporate gym discounts are a result of partnerships between gyms and organisations such as New Zealand Home Loans (NZHL) and Southern Cross. These partnerships allow employees of participating companies to access discounted gym memberships, which can be up to 20% cheaper than standard rates.

sections.heading: How to Negotiate Corporate Rates
sections.body: To negotiate a corporate rate, employers should contact their preferred gym and ask about their corporate discount programme. Some gyms may require a minimum number of employees to sign up, so it's essential to have a clear understanding of the terms and conditions before committing to a corporate membership.

sections.heading: Employee Wellness Programmes
sections.body: In addition to discounted gym memberships, many organisations also offer employee wellness programmes. These programmes can include on-site fitness classes, healthy eating workshops, and mental health support. By promoting employee wellness, organisations can improve productivity, reduce absenteeism, and create a positive work environment.

sections.heading: NZHL and Southern Cross Gym Discounts
sections.body: NZHL and Southern Cross are two of the most popular organisations offering corporate gym discounts in NZ. With a range of gyms to choose from, including Jetts 24/7 Gym and Anytime Fitness, employees can find a gym that suits their needs and budget. NZHL and Southern Cross members can access discounted gym memberships from just $16.95 per week.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.body: Corporate gym discounts are a great way for employees to save money on gym memberships while promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. With a range of gyms and organisations offering discounted memberships, it's essential to compare prices and find the best deal.
